activity_context.topic_title: Solving Decoupled Homogeneous Systems of ODEs

feedback.worked_solution:
We have a decoupled system. Therefore, the general solution is given by

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{3t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{t},\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Now, we need to find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}$ using the initial condition $x(1)=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$ Substituting $t=1$ into the general solution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}x(1) & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{3(1)}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{1} \\ [\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}{e}^{3} \\ {c}_{2}e\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{e}^{-3} \\ -{e}^{-1}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}{c}_{1} \\ {c}_{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to our initial value problem is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & ={e}^{-3}\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{3t}-{e}^{-1}\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{t} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{e}^{-3} \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{3t}+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -{e}^{-1}\end{aligned}]{e}^{t}.\end{aligned}
$$
